page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Left margin: two marginal notes, the first beside "Nec multò", the second beside "re ægro". Below the text: the catchword "functus", set at the right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. intet Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: ultimâ usque hominum memoriâ: nec licè-ret butyrum, caseos, equos, boves, vac-cas, cœteraqué id genus mercimonia alibi quàm Groningæ in stapulæ loco more solito venundare, venumve proponere, vel in re-giones alias prætermitâ Groningâ exportare aut abigere: Excepta modò essent, quæ hujus generis viris nobilibus in prædiis ipsorum provenirent, quibus jus esset pro libitu & commodo suo ea dividere: idemque valeret de Dammonensibus. Exempta quoque stapulæ legi maneret Præfectura vetus, u-tereturquæ jure ac libertate pristinâ, emeret, venderet cerevisiam coqueret pro libitu, uti solebat, quoad duraret hæc sequestris ratio: Groningani etiam in exigendâ pecuniâ credità & redditibus aliis per agrum retinerent jus & morem solitum, modò ut judex in eo tribunali in urbe esset ipse Thorenius, aut legatus ejus, aliúsve pro eo sequester ab Ordinibus Imperii datus. Atque hæc probata signataque ab utrâque parte, & sigillis quoque duorum intercessorum ad fidem munita: denique pax constituta. Albertus [?]Nec multò pòst Albertus jam tum corpo-[illegible, ~8 letters] morsre ægro Emdam delatus, atque tibi vitâ

page.notes: The left-margin notes are small and partly unreadable; the first reads "Albertus" with a doubtful reading, the second is only partly legible. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The running head is copied as printed, including "intet". The text runs on from "vitâ" to the catchword "functus", which is set apart at the lower right. No other printing errors are apparent.
